description: EPA metadata describes WNTR simulation results for landslide exposure and difficult-to-repair pipes in a Pennsylvania drinking-water utility. Population impacts are linked to social-vulnerability measures. This resource is provided by U.S. EPA Office of Research and Development (ORD). Coverage is site as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence terms are linked in the provider metadata and require reading before reuse. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: This is one utility analysis. The catalogue page was read; the underlying spreadsheet and confidential network geometry were not inspected. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-wntr. The relationship follows the named method or resource; it does not certify file compatibility.
